source_evidence: Player exact 'yes' to Cirren 'Ready to see Desen?' following explicit prior D326 plan to present evidence and investigate Tavosk and House Veldrake. Sources prior D327 rest packet, actual D326 evidence chunks, dm-ferry-setup.md @72d5bde0ab9d84d89fdc63f20cf9c7bfb63b1516, D325 Desen prior cooperation. Routine presentation and substantive legitimate investigative decision, no contested check or guarantee of results. Disclosure of origins consistent with honest evidence presentation, not invented player confession or quoted speech; no surrender or unrelated action. D327~08:25 at Western District Watch annex, Orsaven, V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar present with Sgt Rill Desen; coach/four horses at Copper Hart. Exact player 'yes' accepts Cirren's invitation to visit Desen, implementing yesterday's explicit intended plan to present evidence, investigate Tavosk/House Veldrake. Ordinary walk and private meeting, no fee/check. Cirren voluntarily displays his two original exhibits under supervision without surrender: original lot27 invoice36gp from storehouse2 with joint freight account and transfer from storehouse1, original sealed14gp acknowledgement identified by route broker as commercial petition delegate Noldren Tavosk, actual text 'Received fourteen gold pieces for information supplied concerning the forthcoming berth inspections. I shall continue to represent your interests in the matter of selective inspection exemptions.' V presents own notes and actual firsthand narrative: ferry/lighter transfer, landing official receives purse, receiver's warehouse payment and same case of lace sold, D3206gp+D3238gp fee entries charged through broker reimbursement, broker ledger lot27 cross-reference, D321 L-9 instruction to continue lace landed before assessment/no assessed duties, D322 receipt24gp and matching House Veldrake register/agent stamp. Explains originals taken during unauthorized access and invoice theft; no invented lawful seizure or fabricated provenance, no certified original Veldrake documents. Cirren corroborates observations within own knowledge, Fenar confirms what she saw, Mara knows from supper briefing not firsthand. Desen records account/provenance in case notes, independently recognizes seriousness of evidence, commits to open bounded customs/Watch inquiry and seek trusted customs examiner to independently compare actual landing declarations, freight records and Tavosk's seal/office, identify household agent and responsible individuals. May ask competent officers to secure corroborating originals through lawful powers, not accomplished yet, no warrant, arrest, raid, verified new identity or seizure promised. Distinguishes the already upheld Quenwood murders from present smuggling/paid political influence, no guilt established for others in killings or automatic liability for entire House. Paymaster48gp held for restitution identified to Desen, he intends to arrange lawful recovery through existing court process; notification/actual handover/distribution not yet verified, no funds paid. Desen requests to retain two originals with formal evidence receipt, plus faithful copy of V's notes if V consents; V/Cirren still retain all originals/notes and control next decision. Warns against alerting suspects prematurely, offers independent customs route rather than mandatory further break-in; ordinary public inquiries into Tavosk's office or Veldrake household are available if V chooses. No further V speech, expenditure, roll, consent, disclosure beyond private meeting or subsequent investigation assumed. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi4/6 MP7/7 PastLife2/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers0/1 inactive cloak+Luckstone; Cirren51/51 AC19 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 boots +1Shield; Fenar59/59 AC16 HD6/6 Rage4/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40 breastplate/Insignia, natural+9/1d6+6 base or1d6+8 raging mechanical greataxe unchanged. Mara healthy. Purse2047gp8sp6cp rations21/feed28 LR2/6; no new spend/rest. Other obligations unchanged: skiff rescued and Meret referral delivered, no contract; Ossent royal recommendation pending decision, Kestrel copies confidential originals retained; Crown frontier300+1300 contingent; western conditional recovery grant not deed, Coris300 pending optional800 field; magic balance520 target353; Elara Caereth, Severin assent unconfirmed. V dice delegated. Await response on evidence custody and next inquiry.
